lines.text: After John's arrest, Jesus went into Galilee and proclaimed the gospel of God, saying the kingdom of God is near.
Walking beside the Sea of Galilee, Jesus saw the fishermen Simon and his brother Andrew casting a net.
Jesus said He would make them shepherds of Israel, and at once they left their nets and followed Him.
Going farther, Jesus saw James and his brother John, the sons of Zebedee, washing their nets in a boat.
Jesus called James and John, and they left Zebedee in the boat with the hired men and followed Him.
